text:
shout out to everyone who literally cannot remember the last time something broke their way

have u feeling like u were born under a bad sign or some shit

a ghibelline in a world of guelphs

but there's a reason why they say, "success is the ability to go from failure to failure without losing your enthusiasm"

kind of have to just put ur hard hat on, show up, chop wood, and discard any fantasies that the world owes u something

also goes back to that quote from Margin Call

"There have always been, and there always will be, the same percentage of winners and losers in this world. There may be more of us today than there's ever been. But the percentages, they stay exactly the same."

the exact %'s, who knows, prob 99% to 1%

nature is aristocratic by design, there are always far more losers than winners

but as far as what determines which of those two groups u end up in...I mean

thats just a function of what u do today my man, everyone is allotted the same 24 hours and always has been

all a matter of what u make of it

hugo wrote that "no force on earth can stop an idea whose time has come"

sometimes that idea is u

bon courage 🫡
